_about: Card summaries on /case-studies/ for the factory cases. casemodel.py fills each <!--case:<slug>.card--> region in case-studies/index.html from these templates and the case's model values ({name} as in the case's values), and refuses a card whose wording contradicts the computed determination. No market figures here: they belong on the case page, where they are cited.
gas-station-alabama-sba: A hypothetical purchase of an operating branded fuel and convenience store on the Opelika I-85 corridor, tested on the seller's last year under SBA's change-of-ownership rules: {hist_dscr} against the {floor} floor once equity rises to {equity_pct}.
gas-station-florida-sba: A new unbranded fuel and convenience store on US 27 at Lake Wales: traffic is ample but national chains already feed the corridor, so the market carries only {loan_total} of 7(a) debt on a {tpc} project, {dscr_y2} in Year 2 at {equity_pct} equity.
gas-station-georgia-sba: A new commuter fuel and convenience store near I-75 in Bartow County, Georgia: the interchange is saturated for diesel, and the 7(a) loan reaches {dscr_y2} in Year 2 only at {equity_pct} equity.
gas-station-texas-sba: A new branded fuel and convenience store with a kitchen in Lockhart: demand supports the store, the land price limits the loan, and the 7(a) structure needs {equity_pct} equity for {dscr_y2} in Year 2.
truck-stop-texas-sba: An independent truck stop at an I-20 interchange in Terrell: freight demand is real, but at 2026 land and build costs the SBA 504 structure covers Year 2 debt service only {dscr_y2}; the market does not support this loan.
hotel-texas-sba: A new {in_keys}-key limited-service hotel on SH 71 in Bastrop, facing new extended-stay supply: the SBA 504 loan reaches {dscr_y2} in Year 2 at {equity_pct} equity, not at the program minimum.
rv-park-texas-usda: A new RV park with cabins outside Bastrop, on workforce and leisure demand: the USDA B&I loan reaches {dscr_y3} in Year 3 at {equity_pct} equity.
car-wash-texas-sba: A new express tunnel wash in Seguin, in a contested corridor: membership demand, the SBA 504 stack at {equity_pct} equity on a {tpc} project, and {dscr_y2} coverage in Year 2.
rv-boat-storage-texas-sba: RV and boat storage in Granbury, where low covered rents meet high land prices: the SBA 504 structure covers Year 2 debt service only {dscr_y2}; the market does not support this loan.
auto-dealership-texas-sba: A franchised new-vehicle store on the I-20 corridor in Weatherford: the case turns on a manufacturer's award, and the SBA 504 structure reaches {dscr_y2} in Year 2 at {equity_pct} equity.
assisted-living-texas-hud: An assisted living and memory care community of {units} units in Boerne: strong older demand, but local rates are too low for a full HUD 232 loan; the insured loan reaches {dscr_y3} in Year 3 at {equity_pct} equity.
meat-processing-texas-usda: A USDA-inspected beef harvest and processing plant in Elgin: the USDA B&I loan reaches {dscr_y3} in Year 3 at {equity_pct} equity, with throughput contracts and wastewater as conditions.
gas-station-versailles-ohio-sba: A new branded fuel and convenience store with a kitchen in Versailles, Ohio: the village has room for one modest store, and the 7(a) loan reaches {dscr_y2} in Year 2 at {equity_pct} equity, subject to the tank approvals.
lodging-retreat-johnson-city-texas-sba: A new {in_cabins}-cabin Hill Country retreat near Johnson City: weekend demand supports a small retreat, and the 7(a) loan reaches {dscr_y2} in Year 2 at {equity_pct} equity.
travel-center-hankamer-texas-usda: An independent travel center on I-10 at Hankamer: thin truck parking supports it, and the USDA B&I loan reaches {dscr_y3} in Year 3 at {equity_pct} equity.
